ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent charges and ongoing investigations into Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the $90M scheme and the removal of over 3,400 Medicaid providers.
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How effective are the state's efforts to prevent and detect fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and highlight the need for improved oversight and accountability in the state's Medicaid program. By following the money and analyzing public records, we can shed light on the scope of the problem and identify areas for reform.
